fields.description: Internal POS fulfillment lifecycle that drives the Pending Order queue / Dispose eligibility / serial write-back. Hidden from the form (managed automatically); the visible status is WooCommerce Status.
fields.label: Fulfillment Status

fields.description: Live WooCommerce order status (processing, completed, on-hold, cancelled, refunded, …). Mirrors the WC side; distinct from the POS fulfillment Order Status above.
fields.label: WooCommerce Status

fields.description: When the POS fulfillment status became Transferred (the order left: disposed, auto-cleared or picked up). Revenue is recognised on this date, even when the booking job runs later.
fields.label: Transferred At

fields.description: Distributor fulfilment progress. Blank = no drop-ship line. order_status keeps its three values (#10).
fields.label: Drop-ship Status

fields.description: Derived from the licence number itself (segment 4 == 03), never hand-set. A Type 03 collector receives the firearm at their own licensed premises, so this order ships to the buyer and is verified by staff at dispose.
fields.label: C&R (03) Transfer

fields.description: Monotonic revision of the FFL selection on WooCommerce. A webhook may only overwrite the FFL fields when it carries a HIGHER revision than the one stored here — that is what makes a staff edit on Woo authoritative while leaving ordinary order.updated traffic (status, refunds, serial backfill) unable to touch the FFL.
fields.label: Woo FFL Revision

fields.description: Resolved ATF FFL Record for the receiving dealer (cached when the order is disposed). Powers the expiry gate + the disposition destination.
fields.label: ATF FFL Record

fields.description: Exactly as printed on the collector's licence — this becomes the FastBound contact's licenseName.
fields.label: Collector Name (as printed on license)

fields.description: Read off the licence copy at dispose. Deliberately NOT pre-filled across orders: a licence that was valid last time may have lapsed since.
fields.label: C&R License Expiration

fields.description: Who compared these details against the licence. Deliberate semantics: a dispose RETRY that submits identical values keeps the original verifier (the retry changed no fact, so it must not rewrite history), while CHANGED values re-stamp to whoever entered them. The A&D trail must answer "who vouches for the data stored now", not "who touched this order first" — do not "simplify" this to an unconditional overwrite or an unconditional keep.
fields.label: Verified By

fields.description: When the details on this order were attested to. Follows cr_verified_by: preserved across an identical re-submission, refreshed when the verified values actually change.
fields.label: Verified At
